wholePhysicalScope: The 32-point ovoid map outline spans approximately 122 m by 176 m. The institutional architecture guide places the museum in the Casa de la Cultura complex and describes the roofed Ágora.
lodDetails: All levels retain the ovoid envelope, Ágora roof, three dark glass bands and the recessed entrance. Near levels add mullions, glazing variations and the museum sign.
limitations: The mapped envelope and approximate 10 m height control the low oval form. Curtain wall rhythm, roof curvature and service elevations are approximations based on the documented forms.
The museum entrance and lower service plinth are approximate placements. The sloping original DEM supplies terrain context and is preserved without flattening.
